_source_note: Transcribed 2026-08-13 from the Daggerheart SRD's Core GM Mechanics chapter, cross-checked against two independent SRD mirrors (daggerheartsrd.com/rules/core-gm-mechanics, daggerheart.su/rule/example-gm-moves) which converged on the same 16 moves in the same order and the same 5 trigger conditions. Wording is a best-effort transcription, not a verified character-for-character quote against the official PDF -- spot-check against the primary source before treating this as a legal-grade verbatim citation. See NOTICE.md for the SRD's own attribution terms.
when_to_move: Rolls with Fear on an action roll
Does something that would have consequences
Looks to them for what happens next

soft_vs_hard.soft: Soft moves go easier on the players -- they give the party new information about the scene and offer them an opportunity to react to it.
soft_vs_hard.hard: Hard moves are harsher, more impactful, or more direct -- the PCs don't get an opening to interrupt, alter, or anticipate the outcome.
soft_vs_hard.guidance: Apply softer moves in response to Hope rolls and harder moves in response to Fear rolls.

moves: Ask a question and build on the answer
Make an NPC act in accordance with their motive
Drive a PC to take action by dangling their goals in front of them
Reveal an unwelcome truth or unexpected danger
Force the group to split up
Make a move the characters don't see
Use a PC's backstory against them
